newsitem.title: THAILAND: China buys Thai raw sugar for Mar/May -traders.
newsitem.headline: China buys Thai raw sugar for Mar/May -traders.

text.p: China has bought more than five cargoes of Thai raw sugar for March-May shipment, Thai trade sources said on Tuesday.
The purchase was on a free-on-board basis but there were no details about price.
Thai raw premiums for March/May delivery were quoted around 0.75 cent a pound over New York futures.
"They (China) entered the market two to three weeks ago," said one trader.
"The intention of their purchase was not clear given the amount of stock they have. Perhaps the prices have dropped to a level they saw as attractive," he said.
